methodology.scope: German Bosch floor and upright vacuum model references; no robots, standalone compact handhelds, attachments or article-count inflation.
methodology.identityRule: One source-reported VIB/canonical base code plus a separately reported device material and distinct manufacturer GTIN; /xx indices, multiple URLs, colour labels and country suffixes never produce additional rows. All accepted sources report their own canonical code, not a shop alias.
methodology.indexRule: Read the full E-Nr. from the Service page entrySectionData.variantId AND productId. A requested /xx URL, a 404 or a related model family is never evidence of that index. The checked index list is deliberately non-exhaustive.
methodology.partsRule: No new parts or assignments. Each accepted model starts with 0 parts; preserved 102 physical Bosch articles plus 1 other article.
methodology.materialBoundary: Manufacturer device-material metadata is used only for deduplication, not as a spare-part number, model ID or fitment approval. Two existing products do not expose this field; model-code and GTIN checks still cover all 60 baseline records.
methodology.ranking: Selection is a documented catalogue intake, not a German bestseller ranking. No current price, stock or shipping data imported.
